arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-release.XXXXXX)
bundle=/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.telegram-leads-release-45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c.tgz
trap 'sudo -n rm -f -- "$bundle"; rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s "$work/tests" -q
python3 - "$work" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,sys,tarfile
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("release_installer",root/"scripts/deploy_project_only.py")
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
assert "scripts/public_group_discovery.py" in module.RUNTIME_FILES
assert len(module.RUNTIME_FILES)==len(set(module.RUNTIME_FILES))
with tarfile.open(root/"release.tgz","w:gz") as tar:
 for name in module.RUNTIME_FILES:
  file=root/name
  assert file.is_file() and not file.is_symlink()
  tar.add(file,arcname=name,recursive=False)
print("BUNDLE_FILES",len(module.RUNTIME_FILES))
PY
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 600 "$work/release.tgz" "$bundle"
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 "$work/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$bundle" --commit "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c" --expected-installed "655a911595fd49b0eaeb4feec4dc5a0fb4ac61e0"
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); jobs=[x for x in rows if x.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"]; assert len(jobs)==1; m=jobs[0]["pm2_env"]; assert m["status"]=="online" and m["pm_exec_path"]=="/opt/telegram-robot-leads/main.py"; print("PM2_TARGET_ONLINE",True,"REGIONAL_ENV",m.get("TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED","unset"))'
echo READY_FOR_SAFE_STAGE
